name: Green Asparagus & Broccoli Cream Soup (Lantern Night)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table (Lantern Night)
whyItWorks: Blended smooth so mechanical fiber is broken down, but asparagus (fructans) and broccoli (raffinose) can produce gas.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the Potato Cream Soup instead if you are prone to FODMAP gas; otherwise pair with a Lactaid.
